lede_cn: 从 2008 到 2023 的十五年里,五家曾经进过标普 500 的零售商依次申请了破产保护:Circuit City、RadioShack、Sears Holdings、J.C. Penney、Bed Bath & Beyond。同一段时间里,另外五家零售商把它们腾出来的货架、门店和顾客接了过去。今天 XLY 与 XLP 的持仓名单只写着后一半——这就是为什么任何「代表公司」的长期曲线都天然是一份赢家名单。这张图把另一半放回去。
lede_en: Across the fifteen years from 2008 to 2023, five retailers that had been S&P 500 members filed for Chapter 11 in turn: Circuit City, RadioShack, Sears Holdings, J.C. Penney and Bed Bath & Beyond. Over the same stretch, five other retailers took over the shelves, the sites and the customers they gave up. Today's XLY and XLP holdings lists contain only the second half — which is why any long-run chart of representative companies is a list of winners by construction. This one puts the other half back.

casualties.name: Circuit City Stores
casualties.note_cn: 美国第二大消费电子连锁,与其加拿大子公司 InterTAN 同日申请保护;重整未成,次年三月关闭全部门店。
casualties.note_en: The second-largest US consumer-electronics chain filed alongside its Canadian subsidiary InterTAN; reorganisation failed and every store closed the following March.

casualties.name: RadioShack
casualties.note_cn: 特拉华州破产法院第 15-10197 号案;门店网络被拆分出售,品牌几经转手后只剩线上。
casualties.note_en: Case No. 15-10197 in the District of Delaware. The store network was broken up and sold; the brand changed hands repeatedly and survives online only.

casualties.name: Sears Holdings
casualties.note_cn: 曾是美国最大的零售商,2012 年 9 月已被移出标普 500,六年后在纽约南区申请保护。
casualties.note_en: Once the largest retailer in the United States; removed from the S&P 500 in September 2012 and filing in the Southern District of New York six years later.

casualties.name: J. C. Penney Company
casualties.note_cn: 2013 年 12 月被移出标普 500;疫情关店成了最后一击,在得州南区申请保护。
casualties.note_en: Removed from the S&P 500 in December 2013; the pandemic store closures were the last blow, and it filed in the Southern District of Texas.

casualties.name: Bed Bath & Beyond
casualties.note_cn: 2017 年 7 月 26 日被移出标普 500(本站 sp500/changes 有这条记录),六年后在新泽西区申请保护。
casualties.note_en: Removed from the S&P 500 on 2017-07-26 — the removal is on this site's own sp500/changes ledger — and filed in the District of New Jersey six years later.

survivors.name: Walmart
survivors.note_cn: 必需消费一侧的规模基准;在整段灭绝期里持续是标普 500 成分股,并把生鲜与配送做成了防守护城河。
survivors.note_en: The scale benchmark on the Staples side; an S&P 500 constituent throughout the extinction window, turning groceries and delivery into a defensive moat.

survivors.name: Costco Wholesale
survivors.note_cn: 会员制把利润来源从商品毛利搬到了会费,这是它在折扣战里不流血的原因。
survivors.note_en: The membership model moved the profit pool from merchandise margin to fees — the reason it does not bleed in a discount war.

survivors.name: Home Depot
survivors.note_cn: 品类本身抗电商:大件建材的运费与退货成本高,门店半径反而是资产。
survivors.note_en: A category that resists e-commerce: freight and returns on bulky building materials are costly, so the store radius is an asset rather than a liability.

survivors.name: TJX Companies
survivors.note_cn: 尾货折扣模式靠的是别人的库存过剩,所以同行倒下的那几年正是它的补货来源。
survivors.note_en: An off-price model runs on somebody else's excess inventory, so the years its peers were failing were the years its buyers had the most to choose from.

survivors.name: Amazon.com
survivors.note_cn: 五家倒下的公司里有四家把「顾客先来店里」当成前提;这条前提失效的过程,就是这家公司的增长曲线。
survivors.note_en: Four of the five casualties assumed the customer would come to the store first. The failure of that assumption is this company's growth curve.

post_crisis_cn: 这五次破产不是同一场危机的五个受害者——它们相隔十五年,各有各的直接死因。共同的那一条是渠道:五家全部把「顾客会先走进门店」当成不需要论证的前提。幸存的五家里,有三家(WMT、COST、HD)守住了门店但改写了门店的用途,另外两家(TJX、AMZN)干脆把别人的失败当成自己的供给。这也是本卷所有「代表公司」曲线的必要注脚:名单是按今天的持仓选出来的,所以它按定义只包含活下来的那一半。
post_crisis_en: These five bankruptcies are not five victims of one crisis — they are fifteen years apart and each has its own proximate cause. What they share is the channel: all five treated 'the customer walks into the store first' as a premise that needed no defending. Of the five survivors, three (WMT, COST, HD) kept their stores and rewrote what a store is for; the other two (TJX, AMZN) made other people's failure their own supply. This is also the necessary footnote to every representative-company curve in this volume: the roster is drawn from today's holdings, so by construction it contains only the half that lived.
